about: Mutants of hosts/opentui (the schema of hosts/mygo's ledger). Each edit is applied to a copy of the module's file, then the killers run. A killer is dir:Test, where dir is a directory of this Go module (hosts/opentui/<pkg>).

mutants.name: OT0-fetch-no-integrity
mutants.from: if err := CheckIntegrity(data, want); err != nil {
mutants.to: if err := CheckIntegrity(data, want); false && err != nil {
mutants.rule: a tarball whose bytes differ from the pinned sha512 integrity is refused before it is read

mutants.name: OT0-no-struct-size
mutants.rule: every record carries its struct_size (bindc's autofill); OpenTUI refuses one without

mutants.name: OT0-any-abi
mutants.rule: Load refuses a library of another ABI version; the check is generated, so a hand edit is refused

mutants.name: OT1-destroy-leaves-children
mutants.rule: Destroy removes the whole subtree, children first, so no handle of it stays

mutants.name: OT1-move-ignores-index
mutants.rule: Move puts the node at its index among the parent's children

mutants.name: OT1-chunk-drops-escape
mutants.rule: an escape sequence cut between two feeds is one key, not Escape and text

mutants.name: OT1-resize-not-passed
mutants.rule: Resize resizes the renderer, so the scene lays out at the new size

mutants.name: OT1-off-owner-thread
mutants.rule: every library call runs on the owner thread

mutants.name: OT1-close-no-drain
mutants.rule: Close writes the terminal's restoration before it frees the session

mutants.name: OT2-tab-reversed
mutants.from: if back { (at + n - 1) % n } else { (at + 1) % n }
mutants.to: if back { (at + 1) % n } else { (at + n - 1) % n }
mutants.rule: Tab moves the focus to the next focusable node in tree order, Shift+Tab to the one before

mutants.name: OT2-hit-stops-at-text
mutants.rule: the mouse goes to the nearest node that takes input above the scene's hit, not to a text inside a Pressable

mutants.name: OT2-insert-ignores-before
mutants.rule: an Insert puts the node in front of its Before, in the driver's tree and on the scene

mutants.name: OT2-set-text-not-sent
mutants.rule: a Set of a text sets the scene node's text

mutants.name: OT2-remove-leaves-screen
mutants.rule: a Remove destroys the node's scene subtree

mutants.name: OT2-disabled-takes-focus
mutants.rule: Tab passes over the nodes under a disabled Fieldset (a press under it does nothing: the session drops it, ui Fieldset)

mutants.name: OT2-no-reveal
mutants.rule: a tap on a row below a Scroll's fold scrolls it into view first

mutants.name: OT2-window-prints-start
mutants.to:
out.Println("0: \(counter.Summary(tui.StateOf(&d)))")
		for i, act in steps {
mutants.rule: the terminal binary prints what the example's own binary prints, and nothing more

mutants.name: OT2-key-names-collide
mutants.rule: no two key codes have one name

mutants.name: OT2-cells-off-by-half
mutants.rule: a whole multiple of the cell is exactly that many cells

mutants.name: OT2-unsafe-outside-edge
mutants.rule: only ot/ and screen/ import unsafe or C
